subject.title: improve(diagnostics-otel): make agent-duration histograms usable beyond 10s

question: Which diagnostics-otel bucket policy should OpenClaw ship for existing OTel histograms: this narrower run/harness/context set, the broader https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97098 duration set, or no default change yet?
rationale: Both open PRs change aggregation defaults for existing exported metrics, and that operator compatibility choice cannot be resolved by code review or CI alone.

options.title: Pick one policy after proof
options.body: Choose the intended bucket scope, require real OTel export proof on that branch, and close or supersede the competing PR after the decision is recorded.

options.title: Land this narrower scope
options.body: Accept the smaller run/harness/context change if maintainers want to avoid changing every duration histogram in this round.

options.title: Prefer the broader PR
options.body: Use the maintainer-labeled broader duration-metric PR if consistency across all millisecond histograms is the desired policy.

recommendation.title: Pick one policy after proof
recommendation.body: Choose the intended bucket scope, require real OTel export proof on that branch, and close or supersede the competing PR after the decision is recorded.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc owns the clearest recent diagnostics-otel metric and OpenTelemetry migration history for the affected plugin surface.
